title: Exploring Mistral AI: French Startup Revolutionizing Generative Models | ApiX-Drive

facts.fact: The ApiX-Drive blog states that Mistral AI's capitalization is over $6 billion.
facts.quote: its impressive capitalization (over $6 billion)

facts.fact: The ApiX-Drive blog states that Mistral AI has received over $1 billion in investment.
facts.quote: a significant amount of investment (over $1 billion)

facts.fact: Mistral AI was founded in April 2023 by three former Google DeepMind and Meta employees.
facts.quote: The company was founded in April 2023 by three former Google DeepMind and Meta employees

facts.fact: Mistral AI's first funding round in June 2023 raised €113 million.
facts.quote: Its volume amounted to €113 million.

facts.fact: In December 2023, Mistral AI raised another €385 million in its second investment round.
facts.quote: In December 2023, the startup managed to raise another €385 million in its second investment round.

facts.fact: After the December 2023 round, the blog reports Mistral AI's estimated value reached $2 billion.
facts.quote: After that, its estimated value reached $2 billion.

facts.fact: In June 2024, Mistral AI raised a tranche of €600 million, which the blog describes as a record.
facts.quote: In June 2024, the startup raised a record tranche of €600 million.

facts.fact: The blog states that total Mistral AI funding exceeded €1 billion as of June 2024.
facts.quote: the total volume of Mistral AI funding exceeded €1 billion.

facts.fact: Mistral AI's debut product was the open-source Mistral 7B language model, released in September 2023.
facts.quote: Mistral AI's debut product was the open-source Mistral 7B language model, which was released in September 2023.

facts.fact: In February 2024, Mistral AI partnered with Microsoft, including an investment of €15 million and launch of its AI products on Microsoft Azure.
facts.quote: In addition to an investment of €15 million, their collaboration involves the launch of the French startup's AI products on the Microsoft Azure platform.

facts.fact: In January 2025, Mistral AI announced a partnership with Agence France-Presse (AFP).
facts.quote: In January 2025, Mistral AI announced a partnership with Agence France-Presse (AFP).

facts.fact: Mistral AI's open-source LLMs are distributed under the Apache 2.0 license.
facts.quote: publicly available open-source LLMs (distributed under the free Apache 2.0 license)

facts.fact: The blog reports that Mistral Small 3 scores over 81% on MMLU.
facts.quote: with high accuracy (over 81% on MMLU) and low latency (150 tokens/sec)

facts.fact: The blog reports that Mistral Small 3 processes 150 tokens per second.
facts.quote: low latency (150 tokens/sec)

facts.fact: The latest version of Mistral Small 3 was released in January 2025.
facts.quote: The latest version of Mistral Small 3 was released in January 2025.

facts.fact: Pixtral 12B, Mistral's first multimodal model, was released in September 2024 and scores 52.5% on MMMU.
facts.quote: It recognizes text and images with 52.5% accuracy on MMMU.

facts.fact: Mistral Large 2 understands queries in 12 natural languages and over 80 programming languages.
facts.quote: can understand queries in 12 natural languages and over 80 programming languages

facts.fact: The blog claims Mistral Large 2 outperforms Llama 3.1 405B in code generation and mathematical calculations.
facts.quote: In the field of code generation and mathematical calculations, it outperforms Llama 3.1 405B.

facts.fact: Mistral Large 24.11 was released in November 2024.
facts.quote: In November 2024, its new version, Mistral Large 24.11, was released.

facts.fact: Pixtral Large was released in November 2024 with a 128,000-token context window that can process at least 30 high-quality images at a time.
facts.quote: Its context window has 128,000 tokens, allowing it to process at least 30 high-quality images at a time.

facts.fact: Pixtral Large is licensed under the Mistral Research License for educational and scientific use and under the Mistral Commercial License for commercial use.
facts.quote: It is available under the Mistral Research License (MRL) for educational and scientific purposes, and under the Mistral Commercial License for commercial purposes.

facts.fact: Codestral is described as understanding over 80 programming languages.
facts.quote: Codestral. This LLM understands over 80 programming languages
